a.lede: GPU giant puts on a brave face for investors, while analysts say doubts remain over the company's future
a.title: Business as usual, but Huang ain't coming back, says Nvidia

b.lede: The value of Nvidia’s private investments has nearly tripled over the past nine months, fueled by Jensen Huang’s aggressive dealmaking and rising valuations of its existing portfolio companies.
b.title: Nvidia’s startup stakes ballooned to $65B, but Huang’s exit puts future deals in doubt
